slots.jd.consumer-app.about: Fernwood Apps builds consumer apps that people actually enjoy opening. We're a small, remote team, and we're looking for a junior UX designer who wants to learn fast, ship often and care about the details. You'll work closely with a senior designer, take on well-scoped pieces of the product and see your work in users' hands quickly.
slots.jd.consumer-app.duties:
What you'll do
- Sketch and refine wireframes for new screens and flows in our app
- Find and fix accessibility issues, from colour contrast to screen reader labels
- Help plan and run usability sessions with real users
- Turn session notes into clear, prioritized design changes
- Share your work in regular design critiques and iterate on the feedback
slots.jd.consumer-app.needs:
What we're looking for
- 1 or more years of experience in product or UX design
- A solid grounding in interaction design and information architecture
- Comfort working in Figma, including prototyping clickable flows
- Hands-on user research experience, from interviews to usability sessions
- Working knowledge of HTML and CSS so you can collaborate easily with engineers
slots.r1.b1: Builds design system components and organizes them using information architecture principles, reducing the time teammates spend locating the right component by 40 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Runs usability sessions using wireframing to test early layouts with participants before visual design work begins.
slots.r1.b3: Presents usability testing findings in stakeholder reviews to prioritize fixes, reducing task errors by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Applies accessibility fixes to shared components, following design systems practice so each correction carries through to every screen that uses them.
slots.r1.i1: Supports the design team at Neighborhood Table Services by planning and running usability sessions and turning participant feedback into clear design changes.
slots.r1.i2: Produces wireframes for Neighborhood Table Services, working on small, well-defined parts of the product with a senior designer reviewing each draft.
slots.summary.1: Entry-level product and UX designer with about 1 year of experience delivering small, well-defined pieces of work under senior review. Brings skills in journey mapping, design critique, and HTML and CSS to keep designs grounded in user needs and practical to build.
slots.summary.2: Junior UX designer with about 1 year of experience taking on clearly scoped design tasks while a senior colleague reviews the output. Uses journey mapping to frame problems, contributes to design critique, and applies HTML and CSS knowledge when handing work to developers.
